name: probatorium-elysia-server
//build: Bundles src/server.ts into a single dist/server file via Bun's native bundler. --target=bun keeps Bun built-ins external; --minify shaves bytes. The launcher symlink the ansible build_native_competitor task creates execs `bun run dist/server` so the runtime is Bun, not node.
//run: `bun run dist/server` is the canonical entry — invoked by the launcher symlink. CLI args after `--` are forwarded to the script (process.argv).
//versions: Versions are pinned by the committed lockfile and installed frozen (bun install --frozen-lockfile / npm ci). Bumps land only via a reviewed Dependabot PR — never resolved fresh at deploy time. See .gitignore (Rust block) for why.
